verdict.rationale: Drata's Public API v2 exposes read endpoints for Personnel, Controls, Risks, Policies, Devices, Monitoring Tests, and Audits in JSON (an open, machine-readable format), which lets a customer programmatically pull most of their compliance data out. However there is no documented one-click 'export all data' feature, no stated data-portability/account-closure guarantee, and openapi/llms.txt discovery probes 404, undermining full openness claims. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk export or backup feature, explicit data-portability/right-to-leave documentation, and working machine-readable API spec discovery.
